question: Which frequency category has the highest macro f-score for both models?
model_answer: The "Medium" frequency category has the highest macro f-score for both the RECA and GAIT<sub>GAT</sub> models. Specifically, RECA achieves a macro f-score of 0.837 and GAIT<sub>GAT</sub> achieves a score of 0.609 in this category.
